name: player_cache_disable_copter_snd_nodes_and_stop_sample
description: Player::CacheDisableCopterSndNodesAndStopSample lazily caches copter effect nodes, disables the cached sound nodes, and stops the copter sample.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this isolated helper; the current acceptance is tier C equivalence, with tier S work deferred to a coherent Player vehicle/master-type pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x42b630 validates lazy lookup of copter01/copter02 through zClass::FindByTypeAndName bucket 6, subnode caching for healthy and snd_chopper, gwNodeSetActive(node, 0) on non-null cached sound nodes, and the final zSndSample::StopActiveVoicesIfPlaying call.

Native smoke constructs a zClass bucket with copter roots and child nodes, verifies the first call populates all copter globals, disables both sound-node active flags, and reaches the DirectSound Stop backend through the sample.
Native smoke then clears the bucket and verifies a second call uses cached nodes, disables them again, and stops the sample again.
